U I Q E Z C：手柄的 X Y L R ZL ZR
F：按左摇杆　　G：按右摇杆

鼠标：左键点空地走过去，按住不放一直朝光标走；点目标、界面、底部的按键提示和技能 / 药水格；右键 = 返回；滚轮滚列表。

English:
With a keyboard, on-screen button hints show keyboard keys; press anything on a connected controller and they switch to controller letters.

Confirm: J (Space also works)    Back: K (Esc also works)
Return also confirms; acts as = when the page shows an = hint (e.g. Accept after naming)
=: menu / new character    Tab: map
Move: W A S D    D-pad: arrow keys
U I Q E Z C: controller X Y L R ZL ZR
F: press left stick    G: press right stick

Mouse: left click the ground to walk there, hold to keep walking toward the cursor; click targets, the interface, the button hints at the bottom and skill / potion slots; right click = back; wheel scrolls lists.
A connected controller works right away. This page stays in the Help menu.
